prompt: Provide a description of a safety-critical scenario where the ego vehicle is turning at an intersection. The adversarial agent (pedestrian, car, cyclist, or motorcycle) should perform an unexpected behavior that may lead to a collision. Keep it to one or two short sentences.
descriptions: As the ego vehicle performs a left turn through an intersection, a cyclist suddenly swerves into its path from a side street.
While the ego vehicle is executing a left turn at an intersection, a cyclist suddenly swerves into its path from behind a parked delivery truck.
A pedestrian steps out from behind a parked van and enters the roadway just as the ego vehicle begins its right turn.
A pedestrian suddenly steps into the roadway from behind a parked car just as the ego vehicle begins its right turn at the intersection.
A pedestrian suddenly steps into the ego vehicle's path from behind a parked van while it is executing a left turn at the intersection.
